name: cyclic boundary method
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 将有限计算区间随移动车辆更新以实现长距离分析的方法。
usage_note: 本段把循环计算法描述为循环边界方法；仅在该语境中关联为同一策略。

complete_examples.text: As shown in Figure 3, the cyclic calculation method is a cyclic boundary method, its main methodology is limiting the calculation boundary to a certain finite region near the moving vehicle.
